title: PR recommendations
intro: Each line names the material, quantity, date and the lead time and consumption it was derived from. These are proposals for a human to approve; nothing is written to SAP.

tiles.label: PR value due in 90 days
tiles.definition: Inventory position (closing + on order + approved PR awaiting PO) is projected down with the engine monthly means; a line is due when position <= calculated ROP. Order qty refills to calculated Max at the trigger date, raised to MIN_ORDER_QTY and rounded up to ORDER_MULTIPLE. Raise-now = already at/below ROP at 2025-12-31. High priority = raise-now and (VITAL or position <= safety stock). Shutdown-linked = DIM_MATERIAL.SHUTDOWN_MATERIAL_FLAG='Y'.
tiles.source: RAW stock + DIM_MATERIAL; ROP from ContextFlow predict-batch

tiles.label: Lines due
tiles.definition: Materials whose projected position reaches calculated ROP within 90 days.

tiles.label: Raise now
tiles.definition: Already at or below ROP at 2025-12-31.

tiles.label: High priority
tiles.definition: Raise now and (VITAL or position <= safety stock).

tables.title: Curated REORDER_RECOMMENDATION (18 lines), shown beside, not merged

notes: Five materials are not computable on demo scope: no forward forecast (HZL1005107, HZL1005876, HZL1005880, HZL1005932, HZL1005933).
Curated has 18 lines (13 HIGH, 5 shutdown-linked) against 37 derived here (13 high priority, 10 shutdown-linked). The two diverge; both are shown. Curated carries GENERATION_SEED 20260921.
Lead time = planned delivery days + median PR-to-PO of 24 days (RAW, plant HZL_DEMO_05, 27,387 PO-linked lines).
A PR date of 2025-12-31 means raise at once, and for VITAL items that is an availability call before it is a cost call.
